name: @usdk/deliberate
description: usdk-deliberate, in JS: produces a candidate response using an INJECTED capability-llm driver (never imported directly - the host/loader resolves and constructs the driver, then passes it to create(); see docs/UAGENT_ARCHITECTURE.md 'Modularity': 'Drivers implement capabilities; they do not decide whether actions commit', and roles depend on shared contracts, not on a concrete driver package). Distinct check: self-consistency - a candidate is only accepted if its proposed_response matches something this instance actually produced via propose(). Depends only on @usdk/contracts.
